hook.en: A seven-step osteopathic sequence of gentle, rhythmic shoulder movements used for stiff shoulders.
hook.ur: Spencer technique shoulder ke liye saat gentle, rhythmic movements ka osteopathic sequence hai.

goal.en: By the end, you'll know what Spencer Shoulder Technique is, when it's safe and useful, how to apply it step by step — and how to prove it worked. (4 checks along the way.)
goal.ur: End tak aap jaan jayenge ke Spencer Shoulder Technique kya hai, kab safe aur faida-mand hai, qadam ba qadam kaise apply hoti hai — aur kaise prove karein ke kaam kiya. (Raste mein 4 checks.)

text.en: The Spencer technique is a fixed sequence of seven shoulder movements, performed with the patient lying on their side. It is used for stiffness such as adhesive capsulitis. Each step gently moves the shoulder toward its limit in a rhythmic way.
text.ur: Patient side-lying position mein hota hai aur shoulder ko saat movements ke fixed sequence se gently move kiya jata hai. Adhesive capsulitis jaisi stiffness mein istemal kiya jata raha hai; har step shoulder ko rhythm ke sath comfortable limit ki taraf le jata hai.

simpler.en: A seven-step osteopathic sequence of gentle, rhythmic shoulder movements used for stiff shoulders.
simpler.ur: Spencer technique shoulder ke liye saat gentle, rhythmic movements ka osteopathic sequence hai.

text.en: Like a warm-up routine: seven short moves that gradually loosen the shoulder in a planned order.
text.ur: Warm-up routine ki tarah saat chhoti movements shoulder ko planned order mein dheere dheere move karti hain. Yeh analogy hai, cure ka claim nahi.

text.en:
Three ideas carry this whole technique:
**1.** The sequence covers extension, flexion, circumduction (with compression and traction), abduction, adduction with internal rotation, and a final traction step.
**2.** Rhythm and gentle pressure matter more than force.
**3.** Assess shoulder movement before and after.
text.ur: Sequence mein extension, flexion, circumduction compression aur traction ke sath, abduction, adduction with internal rotation aur aakhir mein traction shamil hoti hai. Rhythm aur gentle pressure force se zyada aham hain. Adhesive capsulitis frozen shoulder hai; circumduction arm ko circle mein move karna; side-lying unaffected side par letna; articulation repeated gentle joint movement hai.

text.en:
So when does **Spencer Shoulder Technique** make sense?
• A stiff shoulder in the stiff or recovery phase, once other causes have been screened.
• Practitioners trained in the technique.
text.ur: Screening ke baad stiff ya recovery phase ke shoulder mein, aur trained practitioners ke liye. Shoulder fracture, dislocation, severe pain, infection, neurological signs, ya steps ke dauran dard tez barhne par use na karein.

text.en:
And just as important — when you should NOT use it, or should stop:
• Shoulder fracture, dislocation, severe pain or infection.
• Neurological signs, or pain that rises sharply during the steps.
**Stop rule:** Avoid forceful shoulder movement after recent dislocation, fracture, acute cuff tear, marked instability or unexplained severe weakness.
text.ur: Acute fracture/dislocation suspicion, post-operative restrictions ya severe pain ko ignore karke sequence perform na karein. Symptoms barhne, guarding ya unusual response par stop karein aur relevant medical assessment consider karein.

title.en: How to do it — 6 steps, each with its reason
title.ur: Kaise karein — 6 qadam, har ek ki wajah ke saath

steps.title: Screen and assess range
steps.detail: Record how far the arm lifts and rotates.

steps.title: Position the patient
steps.detail: Lie on the unaffected side with the shoulder supported.

steps.title: Steps 1-2
steps.detail: Gently take the shoulder into extension and flexion within comfort.

steps.title: Steps 3-4
steps.detail: Perform circumduction first with gentle compression, then with gentle traction.

steps.title: Steps 5-6
steps.detail: Move the arm into abduction, then adduction with internal rotation.

steps.title: Step 7 and retest
steps.detail: Finish with gentle rhythmic traction and then retest range.

beats.ur:
1. Range record karein.
2. Patient ko unaffected side par shoulder support ke sath litaayein.
3. Extension aur flexion gently karein.
4. Circumduction pehle gentle compression aur phir traction ke sath karein.
5. Abduction, phir adduction with internal rotation karein.
6. Gentle rhythmic traction se finish karke range dobara check karein.

text.en: How much? Typical teaching range: each step performed gently for several rhythmic repetitions. Follow your training and keep within comfort.
text.ur: Har step ki chand gentle rhythmic repetitions; apni training follow karein aur patient ke comfort ke andar rahein.

beats.patient: Margaret, 63, stiff right shoulder for four months, can lift to 90 degrees.
beats.assessment: Painful and stiff, with no fracture and no nerve signs.
beats.treatment: Seven-step sequence performed gently in side-lying.
beats.reassess: She can lift to 105 degrees and pain is slightly reduced. A home exercise plan follows.
beats.ur:
Ek misal se poora clinical flow dekhein:
Source mein Margaret, 63 saal ki, chaar mahine se stiff right shoulder rakhti hain aur 90 degrees tak lift kar pati hain. Fracture aur nerve signs nahi. Side-lying mein gentle seven-step sequence ke baad lift 105 degrees tak aur pain thora behtar hota hai; home exercise plan follow hota hai. Yeh teaching scenario hai.

text.en:
The mistakes I see most often:
• Forcing past pain.
• Skipping the screen.
• Treating the sequence as a cure.
**Myth to drop:** 'Seven movements means seven times the benefit.' More steps are not automatically better.
text.ur: Pain ke aage force karna, screening skip karna, ya sequence ko cure samajhna. Kitne steps? Saat. Aam use? Adhesive capsulitis jaisa stiff shoulder.

text.en:
Evidence is limited to small studies. It may help stiffness for some, but it is not proven better than other approaches.
The Spencer sequence is a documented osteopathic approach, but high-quality trials isolating this exact sequence are sparse. General shoulder mobility evidence cannot be equated with technique-specific proof.
text.ur: Saat gentle steps, phir retest aur exercise. Evidence chhoti studies tak limited hai; kuch logon ki stiffness mein madad ho sakti hai, magar doosri approaches se behtar hona prove nahi.
